notes: Backlog game, all-AAA pass: picked from RAWG's most-added list for its year across all genres (docs/PLAN.md section 2, genre filter widened 2026-10-23). The Steam schema calls app 601430 "Project Gaiden" (an internal codename); the store list confirms it as "The Evil Within 2". StrategyWiki has no page under "The Evil Within 2" or "The Evil Within II". theevilwithin.fandom.com answers the API under "The Evil Within 2" with about 61 linked articles; names only were looked at, nothing copied. 14 of 51 Steam achievements are hidden and sit in the story chapter; most are above 44%, but "You Asked For It... Again" (3.3%) and "That Cinematic Feel..." (5.8%) are rare and may be extra modes or challenges rather than story. Five visible achievements name a chapter number in their description, so they have their own chapter.
